$schema.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation

server.description: Server configuration for synergy serve and web commands

cors.description: Additional origins allowed for CORS and Browser viewer WebSockets

timeout.description: Timeout configuration for assistant steps, provider requests, tool execution, and permission prompts

invoke_sec.description: Max wall-clock seconds for one assistant step (default: 21600 = 6h)

ttfb_sec.description: Max seconds to wait for first byte (TTFB) from provider. Accommodates reasoning/thinking models (e.g. o1-pro, deepseek-r1). Default: 3600 = 1h

idle_sec.description: Idle timeout in seconds (0/false = disable, default: 900 = 15min). Resets on each data chunk.

wall_sec.description: Hard wall-clock timeout per HTTP request in seconds (0 = disabled, default: 0). CAUTION: conflicts with streaming — will interrupt normal token output. Only enable if you need a hard cap beyond idle+TTFB

default_sec.description: Default timeout per tool execution in seconds (default: 7200 = 2h)

overrides.description: Per-tool timeout overrides by tool name, e.g. { bash: 600, webfetch: 120 }

ask_sec.description: Max seconds to wait for permission approval before auto-denying (default: 3600 = 1h)

maxConcurrentTasks.description: Maximum number of Cortex subagent tasks that may run concurrently (default: 8)

execution.description: Process isolation, worker recycling, and bounded execution scheduling

continueOnDeny.description: Continue the loop after a denied tool call (default: false)

agentWorkers.description: Maximum number of isolated Agent workers (default: min(4, available CPUs - 1), at least 1)

agentWorkerMinIdle.description: Minimum number of idle Agent workers kept warm (default: 0; cannot exceed agentWorkers)

agentWorkerIdleTimeoutMs.description: Time an excess idle Agent worker remains warm before retirement (default: 60000)

agentQueueMax.description: Maximum queued Agent turns waiting for a worker (default: 256)

agentQueueMaxMb.description: Maximum aggregate queued Agent-turn payload size in MiB (default: 256)

agentWorkerMaxTurns.description: Turns completed before an Agent worker is recycled (default: 64)

agentWorkerMaxRssMb.description: Hard RSS limit in MiB for an Agent worker; the soft recycle watermark is half this value (default: 3072)

agentWorkerMaxHeapMb.description: Hard heap-used limit in MiB for an Agent worker; the soft recycle watermark is half this value (default: 2048)

agentWorkerIdleBaselineRecycle.description: Recycle idle Agent workers after post-GC memory grows beyond their warm baseline (default: Linux only)

agentWorkerIdleBaselineRssGrowthMb.description: Allowed post-GC RSS growth above an Agent worker's warm idle baseline in MiB (default: 256)

agentWorkerIdleBaselineExternalGrowthMb.description: Allowed post-GC external-memory growth above an Agent worker's warm idle baseline in MiB (default: 128)

agentCancelGraceMs.description: Grace period before terminating an Agent worker that ignores cancellation (default: 5000)

agentHeartbeatTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time without an Agent worker heartbeat before forced replacement (default: 45000)

policyWorkers.description: Number of isolated Policy workers (default: min(2, available CPUs - 1), at least 1)

policyQueueMax.description: Maximum queued Policy classifications waiting for a worker (default: 256)

policyQueueMaxMb.description: Maximum aggregate queued Policy-classification payload size in MiB (default: 64)

policyTimeoutMs.description: Maximum total time for a Policy classification before conservative fallback (default: 1000)

policyWorkerMaxRequests.description: Classifications completed before a Policy worker is recycled (default: 512)

policyWorkerMaxRssMb.description: RSS threshold in MiB for terminating or recycling a Policy worker (default: 512)

policyWorkerMaxHeapMb.description: Heap-used threshold in MiB for terminating or recycling a Policy worker (default: 256)

policyCancelGraceMs.description: Shutdown grace period before terminating a Policy worker (default: 25)

policyHeartbeatTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time without a Policy worker heartbeat before forced replacement (default: 15000)

toolConcurrency.description: Maximum process-wide concurrent ToolTasks (default: twice available CPUs, bounded to 4-32)

toolQueueMax.description: Maximum queued ToolTasks waiting for execution capacity (default: 32 per tool slot)

toolQueueMaxMb.description: Maximum aggregate queued ToolTask input size in MiB (default: 128)

toolCancelGraceMs.description: Grace period for active ToolTasks during runtime shutdown (default: 3000)

toolExecutorConcurrency.description: Optional concurrency limits for each Tool Executor class

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically. Empty arrays are ignored in each config layer, preserving lower-priority filters

enabled_providers.description: When non-empty, ONLY these providers will be enabled. Empty arrays are ignored in each config layer, preserving lower-priority filters

model.description: Default model in the format of provider/model, eg anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5

nano_model.description: Cheapest model for trivial extraction tasks like title generation, in the format of provider/model. Falls back to mini_model → mid_model → model.

mini_model.description: Lightweight model for simple tasks like intent extraction, in the format of provider/model. Falls back to mid_model → model.

mid_model.description: Mid-tier model for internal agents that need moderate reasoning (script extraction, reward evaluation, code exploration), in the format of provider/model. Falls back to the default model.

thinking_model.description: Deep thinking model for complex reasoning and architecture tasks, in the format of provider/model. Falls back to the default model if not set.

long_context_model.description: Model with extra-large context window for processing very long inputs, in the format of provider/model. Falls back to the default model if not set.

creative_model.description: Model for creative and visual tasks (UI design, writing, artistry), in the format of provider/model. Falls back to the default model if not set.

vision_model.description: Model for separate image analysis via the look_at tool, in the format of provider/model. If not set, look_at is disabled. Direct current-model image context uses view_image based on the active model capability.

role_variant.description: Default variant (e.g. low, medium, high, xhigh) applied per model role. Requires the resolved model to support the named variant.

default_agent.description: Default agent to use when none is specified. Must be a primary agent. Falls back to 'synergy' if not set or if the specified agent is invalid.

username.description: Custom username to display in conversations instead of system username

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

profile.description: Canonical provider profile whose runtime behavior this account connection uses

modelsDevProviderID.description: Models.dev provider id to use as this provider connection's model catalog source

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL for copilot authentication

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

mergeSystemMessages.description: Merge leading system messages into a single system message for strict OpenAI-compatible endpoints that reject multiple or non-leading system messages (e.g. vLLM Qwen chat templates). Default false.

timeout.description: Idle timeout in milliseconds for requests to this provider. Set to false to disable timeout.

anyOf.description: Idle timeout in milliseconds for requests to this provider. Set to false to disable timeout.
Disable timeout for this provider entirely.

sandbox.description: Sandbox configuration for workspace boundary enforcement

enabled.description: Enable the sandbox runtime when available (default: true)

fallbackPolicy.description: How to proceed when the requested sandbox runtime is unavailable (default: 'warn')

backend.description: Force a specific sandbox backend. 'auto' (default) selects the platform-native backend. Valid: 'auto' (platform default), 'seatbelt-deny-default' (macOS deny-default SBPL), 'seatbelt-legacy-allow-default' (macOS allow-default SBPL), 'synergy-sandbox-linux' (Linux bundled bwrap), 'bwrap-inline-debug' (Linux in-tree bwrap debug), 'windows-restricted-token' (Windows MVP), 'windows-elevated' (Windows full, future).

mode.description: Network access mode within the sandbox (default: 'restricted')

denialLogger.description: Log sandbox denials via macOS Seatbelt (default: true)

bundledBwrap.description: Use the bundled bwrap binary instead of system bwrap (default: true)

landlockFallback.description: Fall back to Landlock LSM when bwrap is unavailable (default: true)

helperPath.description: Path to the synergy-sandbox-windows.exe helper binary

verifyHelperHash.description: Verify the helper binary SHA-256 hash before use (default: true)

privateDesktop.description: Create a private desktop for the sandboxed process (default: true)

conpty.description: Use ConPTY for pseudo-terminal support (default: true)

observability.description: Local logs, indexed telemetry, and diagnostics settings

modelSpans.description: Record AI SDK model spans (default: false)

enabled.description: Enable local indexed observability events, spans, metrics, issues, and diagnostics (default: true)

retentionDays.description: Days to retain optional observability mirror files (default: 7)

maxBytes.description: Maximum total local observability storage in bytes (default: 250MB)

stalledToolMs.description: Milliseconds without tool activity before emitting a stalled-tool observability event

enabled.description: Enable structured local performance metrics and traces

metricRetentionMs.description: Milliseconds to retain raw performance metrics

traceRetentionMs.description: Milliseconds to retain performance spans and trace details

maxTraceEvents.description: Maximum related events returned for a trace detail

maxTimelineBuckets.description: Maximum timeline buckets returned to the dashboard

sseBufferSize.description: Performance event stream replay buffer size

redactAttributeKeys.description: Additional performance telemetry attribute keys to redact

jsonlMirrorEnabled.description: Enable optional JSONL mirror files for debugging exports

controlProfile.description: Default control profile applied to all agents

instructions.description: Additional instruction files or patterns to include

project_doc_fallback_filenames.description: Ordered fallback instruction filenames to try when AGENTS.md is missing in a directory

project_doc_max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to include from each automatically discovered instruction file (default: 32768; 0 disables automatic discovery)

smartAllow.description: Use the SmartAllow internal agent to auto-allow high-confidence safe asks in guarded mode and eligible false-positive denies in autonomous mode using metadata or redacted evidence only; full_access does not need SmartAllow

timeout.description: Seconds before unanswered questions auto-expire (0 = no timeout, default 3600 = 1h)

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)

prune.description: Enable pruning of old tool outputs (default: true)

overflowThreshold.description: Fraction of usable context that triggers auto-compaction (default: 0.85)

maxHistoryImages.description: Maximum number of historical images to send as base64 per request (older images replaced with text placeholders). Default: 8.

codexRemote.description: Enable Codex Remote Compaction V2 for openai-codex sessions: request an opaque server-side compaction artifact alongside the local text summary and replay it on later same-model turns (default: false).

coauthorReminder.description: Include the git coauthor reminder in agent prompts (default: true)

category.description: Custom category configurations for background tasks. Categories define model and prompt presets.

model.description: Model to use for this category (e.g., 'sii-openai/GPT-5.2')

promptAppend.description: Additional prompt context to inject for this category

description.description: Description of when to use this category

compatibility.description: Per-source compatibility toggles for discovering Skills from other agent tools

agents.description: Load Agent Skills from .agents/skills directories (default: true)

claude.description: Load Claude Code Skills from .claude/skills directories (default: true)

codex.description: Load Codex Skills from .codex/skills directories (default: true)

openclaw.description: Load OpenClaw Skills from .openclaw/skills and workspace skills directories (default: true)
